equipment.name: Cameleoline
equipment.desc: The model gains a 6+ ward save against ranged attacks, or improves a ward save against ranged attacks it already has by one step (to a maximum of 4+). Only for Praetors and Centurions.

equipment.name: Corvid pattern jump pack
equipment.desc: The model gains +8" movement and the "Jump pack" and "Deep strike" abilities. Replaces a Jump pack. Only for infantry characters.

equipment.name: Infravisor
equipment.desc: The model improves its BS by 1. Only for characters.

equipment.name: Marked for Death
equipment.desc: At the beginning of the first Battle round, select one enemy Character model. Your entire army gains the "Favored Enemy" ability against that model. While that model is attached to a unit, you gain "Favored Enemy" against that unit as well. Unique.

equipment.name: Shadow Master
equipment.desc: The model and its attatched unit may consolidate +3".

equipment.name: The Armor of Shadows
equipment.desc: The model can't be targeted by anything outside of 12". Unique.
